title: Empanada Crusted Tortilla Fritters
description: A crispy twist on traditional empanadas, these fritters are filled with a savory blend of Argentinian flavors.
instructions: Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
In a bowl, mix together crushed empanadas and torn tortilla.
Add oregano and olive oil if using and mix well.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mixture into the hot oil.
Fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Remove from oil and drain on paper towels.
